# Seed: reversible binary extended Euclid (Kaliski family), width-generic.
#
# Classical algorithm (u, v integers; x1, x2 residues mod p):
#     u, v, x1, x2 = a, p, 1, 0          invariant: u = x1*a, v = x2*a (mod p)
#     repeat 2n times:
#         A  u even            : u = u/2,       x1 = x1/2 mod p
#         B  u odd, v even     : v = v/2,       x2 = x2/2 mod p
#         C  both odd, u > v   : u = (u-v)/2,   x1 = (x1-x2)/2 mod p
#         D  both odd, u <= v  : v = (v-u)/2,   x2 = (x2-x1)/2 mod p
#     end: u = 1, v = 0, so x1 = a^-1 mod p.
# Every step at least halves u*v < 2^2n, so v reaches 0 within 2n steps;
# after that case B (v = 0 is even) repeats harmlessly, so no "done" flag.
# Halving x mod p instead of Kaliski's doubling means no Montgomery factor
# 2^k to correct at the end.
#
# Reversible form, per iteration: store two history bits
#     h1 = u0 & v0                 (subtract?)
#     h0 = !u0 ^ (h1 & [u > v])    (operate on u/x1? else v/x2)
# swap (u,x1) <-> (v,x2) when h0 = 0, so the operated register is always "u";
# u -= v & h1; shift u right (a free relabel: its low bit is 0);
# x1 = (x1 - (x2 & h1)) mod p; x1 = x1/2 mod p; swap back.
# Then copy x1 to the output and run the whole forward pass in reverse
# (Bennett), which clears u, v, x1, x2 and the 4n history bits.
#
# Cost: (26n + 8) Toffolis per iteration, 2n iterations, x2 for uncompute
#       ~ 104 n^2 Toffolis; 10n + 7 ancillas.


def build_circuit(c, n, p):
    # ---- registers (little-endian lists of qubit indices) -------------------
    U = c.alloc(n)
    V = c.alloc(n)
    X1 = c.alloc(n)
    X2 = c.alloc(n)
    H = c.alloc(4 * n)        # 2 history bits per iteration
    T = c.alloc(n + 1)        # holds classical constants temporarily
    W = c.alloc(n)            # W = (operand & h1)
    c0, z, flag, gt, o, xh = c.alloc(6)

    # ---- arithmetic primitives ----------------------------------------------
    def maj(x, y, w):
        c.cx(w, y)
        c.cx(w, x)
        c.ccx(x, y, w)

    def uma(x, y, w):
        c.ccx(x, y, w)
        c.cx(w, x)
        c.cx(x, y)

    def add(a, b, carry=None):
        # Cuccaro ripple adder: b += a (mod 2^len), carry ^= carry-out. 2m Toffolis.
        m = len(a)
        prev = c0
        for i in range(m):
            maj(prev, b[i], a[i])
            prev = a[i]
        if carry is not None:
            c.cx(a[m - 1], carry)
        for i in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
            uma(c0 if i == 0 else a[i - 1], b[i], a[i])

    def sub(a, b):
        # b -= a (mod 2^len)
        m0 = c.mark()
        add(a, b)
        c.invert_since(m0)

    def compare(a, b, out):
        # out ^= [b > a]: carry-out of (~a + b), then uncompute. 2m Toffolis.
        for q in a:
            c.x(q)
        m0 = c.mark()
        prev = c0
        for i in range(len(a)):
            maj(prev, b[i], a[i])
            prev = a[i]
        m1 = c.mark()
        c.cx(a[-1], out)
        c.append_inverse(m0, m1)
        for q in a:
            c.x(q)

    def load(reg, k, ctrl=None):
        for i in range(len(reg)):
            if (k >> i) & 1:
                if ctrl is None:
                    c.x(reg[i])
                else:
                    c.cx(ctrl, reg[i])

    def add_const(k, b, ctrl=None):
        # b += k (mod 2^len(b)), optionally controlled. Loading k is Toffoli-free.
        t = T[: len(b)]
        load(t, k, ctrl)
        add(t, b)
        load(t, k, ctrl)

    def mod_add(a, b):
        # b = (b + a) mod p for a, b in [0, p)
        add(a, b, z)                         # (b,z) = a + b
        bz = b + [z]
        add_const((1 << (n + 1)) - p, bz)    # (b,z) = a + b - p; z = sign
        c.cx(z, flag)
        add_const(p, bz, flag)               # add p back if negative; z -> 0
        compare(b, a, flag)                  # flag ^= [a > b]
        c.x(flag)                            # flag was [b_new >= a]; now 0

    def mod_sub(a, b):
        # b = (b - a) mod p
        m0 = c.mark()
        mod_add(a, b)
        c.invert_since(m0)

    def mod_half(x, spare):
        # x = x / 2 mod p. Returns the relabelled register and the new spare.
        c.cx(x[0], o)                        # o = x odd
        add_const(p, x + [spare], o)         # x + o*p is even, < 2^(n+1)
        newx = x[1:] + [spare]               # shift right by relabelling
        k = (p - 1) // 2
        load(T[:n], k)
        compare(T[:n], newx, o)              # o ^= [x/2 > (p-1)/2], which equals o
        load(T[:n], k)
        return newx, x[0]

    def cswap(s, A, B):
        for i in range(len(A)):
            c.cx(B[i], A[i])
            c.ccx(s, A[i], B[i])
            c.cx(B[i], A[i])

    # ---- forward pass -------------------------------------------------------
    start = c.mark()
    for i in range(n):
        c.cx(c.inp[i], U[i])
    load(V, p)
    c.x(X1[0])

    for it in range(2 * n):
        h0 = H[2 * it]
        h1 = H[2 * it + 1]
        c.ccx(U[0], V[0], h1)
        c.x(h0)
        c.cx(U[0], h0)
        compare(V, U, gt)                    # gt = [u > v]
        c.ccx(h1, gt, h0)
        compare(V, U, gt)                    # gt = 0
        c.x(h0)                              # h0 now 1 iff we must swap
        cswap(h0, U, V)
        cswap(h0, X1, X2)

        for i in range(n):
            c.ccx(h1, V[i], W[i])
        sub(W, U)
        for i in range(n):
            c.ccx(h1, V[i], W[i])
        U = U[1:] + U[:1]                    # u is even: shift right for free

        for i in range(n):
            c.ccx(h1, X2[i], W[i])
        mod_sub(W, X1)
        for i in range(n):
            c.ccx(h1, X2[i], W[i])
        X1, xh = mod_half(X1, xh)

        cswap(h0, X1, X2)
        cswap(h0, U, V)
        c.x(h0)                              # restore stored history bit
    end = c.mark()

    # ---- copy result, then uncompute everything -----------------------------
    for i in range(n):
        c.cx(X1[i], c.out[i])
    c.append_inverse(start, end)

# Seed: reversible Bernstein-Yang divsteps inversion, width-generic.
#
# Classical algorithm (f, g signed integers; u, v residues mod p):
#     delta, f, g, u, v = 1, p, a, 0, 1      invariant: f = u*a, g = v*a (mod p)
#     repeat ITERS times:
#         if delta > 0 and g odd:   delta, f, g = 1 - delta, g, (g - f)/2
#                                   u, v       = v, (v - u)/2 mod p
#         elif g odd:               delta, g = 1 + delta, (g + f)/2;  v = (v + u)/2 mod p
#         else:                     delta, g = 1 + delta, g/2;        v = v/2 mod p
#     end: g = 0, f = +-1, so a^-1 = +-u mod p.
# ITERS = floor((49n + 80)/17) is Bernstein-Yang's proven bound for n-bit inputs;
# once g = 0 the "g even" case repeats harmlessly, so no "done" flag.
#
# Reversible form, per iteration: store s = [delta > 0] & g0 and t = g0.
# The swap-and-subtract case is done without swaps or negations:
#     g -= f; f += g     (f becomes old g, g becomes g - f)
#     v -= u; u += v     (same on the coefficients, mod p)
# then g += f, v += u when t & !s; arithmetic-shift g (a relabel plus one
# CNOT for sign extension); v = v/2 mod p. delta is kept as e = delta - 1 so
# that [delta > 0] is just the sign bit of e: case 1 is e = ~e (CNOTs), else
# e += 1. Copy +-u to the output, then run the forward pass in reverse (Bennett).
#
# Cost ~ (46n + 40) Toffolis per iteration, ~2.9n iterations, x2 for uncompute.
# More iterations than binary Euclid, but no n-bit comparator per step.


def build_circuit(c, n, p):
    m = n + 2                                  # signed width of f, g
    iters = (49 * n + 80) // 17
    eb = (iters + 2).bit_length() + 1          # signed width of e = delta - 1

    F = c.alloc(m)
    G = c.alloc(m)
    U = c.alloc(n)
    V = c.alloc(n)
    E = c.alloc(eb)
    H = c.alloc(2 * iters)                     # history: s, t per iteration
    T = c.alloc(max(n + 1, eb))                # classical constants
    W = c.alloc(m)                             # W = operand & control
    c0, z, flag, o, vsp, gsp, cc = c.alloc(7)

    # ---- arithmetic primitives (same as the binary_euclid seed) -------------
    def maj(x, y, w):
        c.cx(w, y)
        c.cx(w, x)
        c.ccx(x, y, w)

    def uma(x, y, w):
        c.ccx(x, y, w)
        c.cx(w, x)
        c.cx(x, y)

    def add(a, b, carry=None):
        # b += a (mod 2^len), carry ^= carry-out. Cuccaro, 2m Toffolis.
        k = len(a)
        prev = c0
        for i in range(k):
            maj(prev, b[i], a[i])
            prev = a[i]
        if carry is not None:
            c.cx(a[k - 1], carry)
        for i in range(k - 1, -1, -1):
            uma(c0 if i == 0 else a[i - 1], b[i], a[i])

    def sub(a, b):
        m0 = c.mark()
        add(a, b)
        c.invert_since(m0)

    def compare(a, b, out):
        # out ^= [b > a]
        for q in a:
            c.x(q)
        m0 = c.mark()
        prev = c0
        for i in range(len(a)):
            maj(prev, b[i], a[i])
            prev = a[i]
        m1 = c.mark()
        c.cx(a[-1], out)
        c.append_inverse(m0, m1)
        for q in a:
            c.x(q)

    def load(reg, k, ctrl=None):
        for i in range(len(reg)):
            if (k >> i) & 1:
                if ctrl is None:
                    c.x(reg[i])
                else:
                    c.cx(ctrl, reg[i])

    def add_const(k, b, ctrl=None):
        t = T[: len(b)]
        load(t, k, ctrl)
        add(t, b)
        load(t, k, ctrl)

    def mod_add(a, b):
        # b = (b + a) mod p
        add(a, b, z)
        bz = b + [z]
        add_const((1 << (n + 1)) - p, bz)
        c.cx(z, flag)
        add_const(p, bz, flag)
        compare(b, a, flag)
        c.x(flag)

    def mod_sub(a, b):
        m0 = c.mark()
        mod_add(a, b)
        c.invert_since(m0)

    def mod_half(x, spare):
        c.cx(x[0], o)
        add_const(p, x + [spare], o)
        newx = x[1:] + [spare]
        k = (p - 1) // 2
        load(T[:n], k)
        compare(T[:n], newx, o)
        load(T[:n], k)
        return newx, x[0]

    def and_into(ctrl, src, dst):
        for i in range(len(src)):
            c.ccx(ctrl, src[i], dst[i])

    Wn = W[:n]

    # ---- forward pass -------------------------------------------------------
    start = c.mark()
    load(F, p)
    for i in range(n):
        c.cx(c.inp[i], G[i])
    c.x(V[0])

    for it in range(iters):
        s = H[2 * it]
        t = H[2 * it + 1]
        c.cx(G[0], t)                          # t = g odd
        c.x(E[-1])
        c.ccx(E[-1], G[0], s)                  # s = (e >= 0) & g odd
        c.x(E[-1])
        c.cx(t, cc)
        c.cx(s, cc)                            # cc = t & !s  (s implies t)

        # integers: case s: g -= f; f += g.  case cc: g += f.
        and_into(s, F, W)
        sub(W, G)
        and_into(s, F, W)
        and_into(s, G, W)
        add(W, F)
        and_into(s, G, W)
        and_into(cc, F, W)
        add(W, G)
        and_into(cc, F, W)
        c.cx(G[-1], gsp)                       # g is even: arithmetic shift right
        G, gsp = G[1:] + [gsp], G[0]

        # coefficients mod p: case s: v -= u; u += v.  case cc: v += u.  v /= 2.
        and_into(s, U, Wn)
        mod_sub(Wn, V)
        and_into(s, U, Wn)
        and_into(s, V, Wn)
        mod_add(Wn, U)
        and_into(s, V, Wn)
        and_into(cc, U, Wn)
        mod_add(Wn, V)
        and_into(cc, U, Wn)
        V, vsp = mod_half(V, vsp)

        # e = delta - 1:  case s: e = ~e (delta = 1 - delta).  else e += 1.
        for q in E:
            c.cx(s, q)
        c.x(s)
        add_const(1, E, s)
        c.x(s)

        c.cx(t, cc)
        c.cx(s, cc)                            # cc = 0
    end = c.mark()

    # ---- output +-u, then uncompute -----------------------------------------
    for i in range(n):
        c.cx(U[i], c.out[i])
    sign = F[-1]                               # f = -1: a^-1 = p - u
    for i in range(n):
        c.cx(sign, c.out[i])                   # out = 2^n - 1 - u
    add_const((p + 1) % (1 << n), c.out, sign) # out = p - u
    c.append_inverse(start, end)

def build_circuit(c, n, p):
    iters = (p * (p - 1)).bit_length()
    L = max(iters, n) + 1
    U = list(c.inp)
    nhu = min(iters, n - 1)
    nfresh = iters - nhu

    B = ((2 * p - 2) << iters) // (p + 1)
    needE = L
    Bt = B
    for j in range(iters):
        Bt = (Bt + p) // 2
        needE = max(needE, j + 1 + Bt.bit_length())
    wY = Bt.bit_length()
    needE = max(needE, iters + wY)
    extE = max(0, needE - L - n)
    lenE = L + n + extE

    def popc(x):
        return bin(x).count('1')

    def inv2r(r):
        mod = 1 << r
        t = 1
        for _ in range(r + 2):
            t = (t * (2 - p * t)) % mod
        return t

    RI = {}
    for r in range(1, min(6, iters) + 1):
        mod = 1 << r
        ip = inv2r(r)
        Ks = [(x + ((-x * ip) % mod) * p) >> r for x in range(mod)]
        kb = max(Ks).bit_length()
        anf = []
        mons = set()
        for i in range(kb):
            co = [(K >> i) & 1 for K in Ks]
            for k in range(r):
                for x in range(mod):
                    if (x >> k) & 1:
                        co[x] ^= co[x ^ (1 << k)]
            terms = [x for x in range(mod) if co[x]]
            anf.append(terms)
            for x in terms:
                if popc(x) >= 2:
                    mons.add(x)
        stack = list(mons)
        while stack:
            s = stack.pop()
            hb = s.bit_length() - 1
            par = s ^ (1 << hb)
            if popc(par) >= 2 and par not in mons:
                mons.add(par)
                stack.append(par)
        RI[r] = (anf, mons, kb)

    def choose(j, Bc, nfree):
        best = None
        for r in range(1, min(6, iters - j) + 1):
            Bn = (Bc + ((1 << r) - 1) * p) >> r
            w = Bn.bit_length()
            if j + r + w > lenE:
                continue
            anf, mons, kb = RI[r]
            if kb > w:
                continue
            M = len(mons)
            avail = nfree + lenE - (j + r + w)
            if w + M > avail:
                continue
            cost = (2.0 * w + 2.0 * M) / r
            if best is None or cost < best[0]:
                best = (cost, r, w, Bn, anf, mons, M)
        return best

    def plan(nfree):
        j = 0
        Bc = B
        tot = 0
        while j < iters:
            b = choose(j, Bc, nfree)
            if b is None:
                return None
            tot += 2 * b[2] + 2 * b[6]
            Bc = b[3]
            j += b[1]
        return tot

    Tloop = 0
    for it in range(iters):
        w = min(n, max(1, iters - it))
        wc = min(n, it + 1)
        if it > 0:
            Tloop += 2
            if w > 1:
                Tloop += 2 * (w - 1) + 2
        Tloop += w + wc + 3 * (w - 1) + 3 * wc
    tcmp = 2 * wY if Bt > p else 0

    baseTSF = n + 1 + (n - 1 - nhu)
    nHf = nfresh - 1 if nfresh >= 2 else nfresh
    anc_base = n + n + L + nHf + 2 + extE
    Qbase = 2 * n + anc_base
    budget = len(c.anc)
    best_extra = None
    best_sc = None
    for extra in range(0, 4 * n + 64):
        if anc_base + extra > budget:
            break
        nT = baseTSF + extra
        if Bt > p and nT < wY:
            continue
        tot = plan(nT + 1)
        if tot is None:
            continue
        sc = (Tloop + tot + tcmp) * (Qbase + extra)
        if best_sc is None or sc < best_sc:
            best_sc = sc
            best_extra = extra

    V = c.alloc(n)
    CU = c.alloc(n)
    CV = c.alloc(L)
    Hf = c.alloc(nHf) if nHf > 0 else []
    S = c.alloc(2)
    EX = c.alloc(extE) if extE > 0 else []
    TX = c.alloc(best_extra) if best_extra > 0 else []

    HQ = []
    for it in range(iters):
        k = iters - it
        if k < n:
            HQ.append(U[k])
        elif nfresh >= 2 and it >= 1:
            HQ.append(Hf[it - 1])
        else:
            HQ.append(Hf[it])

    def maj(x, y, w):
        c.cx(w, y)
        c.cx(w, x)
        c.ccx(x, y, w)

    def uma(x, y, w):
        c.ccx(x, y, w)
        c.cx(w, x)
        c.cx(x, y)

    def add(a, b, cin):
        m = len(a)
        prev = cin
        for i in range(m):
            maj(prev, b[i], a[i])
            prev = a[i]
        for i in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
            uma(cin if i == 0 else a[i - 1], b[i], a[i])

    def cadd(ctl, a, b, cin):
        m = len(a)
        prev = cin
        for i in range(m):
            maj(prev, b[i], a[i])
            prev = a[i]
        for i in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
            x = cin if i == 0 else a[i - 1]
            c.ccx(x, b[i], a[i])
            c.ccx(ctl, x, b[i])
            c.cx(a[i], x)
            c.cx(a[i], b[i])

    def csub(ctl, a, b, cin):
        m0 = c.mark()
        cadd(ctl, a, b, cin)
        c.invert_since(m0)

    def compare(a, b, out, cin):
        for q in a:
            c.x(q)
        m0 = c.mark()
        prev = cin
        for i in range(len(a)):
            maj(prev, b[i], a[i])
            prev = a[i]
        m1 = c.mark()
        c.cx(a[-1], out)
        c.append_inverse(m0, m1)
        for q in a:
            c.x(q)

    def load(reg, k, ctrl=None):
        for i in range(len(reg)):
            if (k >> i) & 1:
                if ctrl is None:
                    c.x(reg[i])
                else:
                    c.cx(ctrl, reg[i])

    def cswap(s, A, B2):
        for i in range(len(A)):
            c.cx(B2[i], A[i])
            c.ccx(s, A[i], B2[i])
            c.cx(B2[i], A[i])

    start = c.mark()
    load(V, p)
    c.x(CV[0])
    for it in range(iters):
        h1 = HQ[it]
        sp = S[it % 2]
        sc = S[(it + 1) % 2]
        cz = CV[-1]
        w = min(n, max(1, iters - it))
        Uw = U[:w]
        Vw = V[:w]
        if it == 0:
            c.cx(U[0], h1)
            c.cx(U[0], sc)
            c.x(sc)
        else:
            c.ccx(U[0], V[0], h1)
            c.cx(U[0], sc)
            c.cx(V[0], U[0])
            c.ccx(sp, U[0], sc)
            c.cx(V[0], U[0])
            c.x(sc)
            if w > 1:
                for q in Vw[1:]:
                    c.x(q)
                m0 = c.mark()
                prev = sp
                for i in range(1, w):
                    maj(prev, Uw[i], Vw[i])
                    prev = Vw[i]
                m1 = c.mark()
                c.ccx(h1, Vw[w - 1], sc)
                c.append_inverse(m0, m1)
                for q in Vw[1:]:
                    c.x(q)
                c.ccx(h1, sp, sc)
            c.cx(sp, sc)
        wc = min(n, it + 1)
        cswap(sc, Uw, Vw)
        cswap(sc, CU[:wc], CV[:wc])
        if it > 0:
            c.cx(sp, sc)
            c.cx(sc, sp)
            c.cx(CV[0], sp)
        csub(h1, Uw[1:], Vw[1:], cz)
        c.cx(h1, Vw[0])
        V = V[1:] + V[:1]
        cadd(h1, CV[:wc], CU[:wc], cz)
        CV = CV[-1:] + CV[:-1]
        if it == 0:
            c.cx(CV[1], h1)

    c.x(U[0])
    load(CU, p)
    E = CV + CU + EX
    TSF = list(V) + [U[0]] + U[nhu + 1:] + TX
    cin = S[0]
    f = S[1]
    nfree = len(TSF) + 1

    j = 0
    Bc = B
    while j < iters:
        cost, r, w, Bn, anf, mons, M = choose(j, Bc, nfree)
        X = E[j:j + r]
        R = E[j + r:j + r + w]
        free = TSF + E[j + r + w:] + [f]
        T = free[:w]
        pool = free[w:]
        order = sorted([(popc(s), s) for s in mons])
        mq = {}
        m0 = c.mark()
        for idx in range(len(order)):
            s = order[idx][1]
            q = pool[idx]
            mq[s] = q
            hb = s.bit_length() - 1
            par = s ^ (1 << hb)
            if popc(par) >= 2:
                a = mq[par]
            else:
                a = X[par.bit_length() - 1]
            c.ccx(a, X[hb], q)
        for i in range(len(anf)):
            for s in anf[i]:
                pc = popc(s)
                if s == 0:
                    c.x(T[i])
                elif pc == 1:
                    c.cx(X[s.bit_length() - 1], T[i])
                else:
                    c.cx(mq[s], T[i])
        m1 = c.mark()
        add(T, R, cin)
        c.append_inverse(m0, m1)
        Bc = Bn
        j += r

    Y = E[iters:iters + wY]
    if Bt > p:
        T = TSF[:wY]
        load(T, p)
        compare(T, Y, f, cin)
        load(T, p)
        d = (p + 1) ^ 1
        for i in range(wY):
            if (d >> i) & 1:
                c.cx(f, Y[i])
    end = c.mark()
    for i in range(min(n, wY)):
        c.cx(Y[i], c.out[i])
    c.append_inverse(start, end)
